name: readthrough
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.role: Toledano et al., Nat Genet 56:1914-1924 (2024), PMID 39174735, supplementary table 3: 5,837 measured premature stop codons x 8 compounds, as percent of the no-PTC control. Gitignored under build/: a rebuildable download, not a source file
the case's stop codon, its +4 and -1 bases and its NMD verdict (gitignored: the file holds transcript offsets)

controls.panel: the named benchmark panel, held out of the fit before any run

assumptions: readthrough rate depends far more on the stop codon and its +4/-1 context than on the gene it sits in, so a group mean learned on other genes' stops transfers to this one
limitations: one reporter assay in one cell line (HEK293T), 144 nt of native context and no chromatin; a percent-of-no-PTC reporter number is not a percent of endogenous protein
validation: every drug's row carries its own held-out control, on a benchmark panel named before the run and on a random fifth of contexts; a row whose control failed is not interpretable as a prediction. The dataset's own untreated column runs through the identical pipeline as a negative control and must fail

sources.literature: PMID:39174735 (measured readthrough, 5,837 pathogenic PTCs); PMID:4140506, PMID:7585968, PMID:17407155 (Bloom syndrome genotype-phenotype)
sources.clinical: none: this is a transfer case used to measure the route's portability. No patient of this project has Bloom syndrome and no HPO term is read here
sources.genomic: a published allele of the BLM gene, read from the literature; no callset, no genomic position, no patient sequence
sources.public: Ensembl REST (transcript model, CDS) and UniProt P54132 (domains)

columns.predicted_readthrough: group mean for this stop codon and context, in the assay's unit
columns.backoff_level: which key answered: stop+4-1, stop+4, stop or drug
columns.control_passed: the drug's own held-out control on the declared benchmark panel

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
patient_data: none in this file. Sequence-derived facts are stated as codon identity, exon index, counts and fractions; no genomic position and no run of patient sequence appears
